answer: Numbers first. Uptime must be continuous for 720 hours before any balance unlocks, and a 1-hour gap resets the clock. A farm of 200 seats pays 200 times 720 hours of hosting, about 5,760 machine-hours per month, before it sees a token. One island of cheap VMs dies at the first reboot. The pearl is not the reward, it is the 30-day clock nobody can shortcut, and a tundra of idle accounts has no cover.
